mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_notice n WHERE n.deleted = 0 AND n.status = 0 AND n.publish_time <= #{now} AND (n.recipient_user_id IS NULL OR n.recipient_user_id = #{userId}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_notice_read r WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.notice_id = n.id AND r.deleted = 0)
